notes: 2018_01 is an HR page; 2018_02 is the TAUP agreement; 2018_03 is an agreement summary. 2018_00_link is a copy of 2018_01.

Governing document: the Temple-TAUP collective agreement (Oct 15, 2014 - Oct 15, 2018), in force on the reference date. The only saved copy is headed 'DRAFT CONTRACT - July 24, 2015' (per the version note): every component citing it is flagged version_uncertain. The HR page is a summary that defers to the agreement; the 2018_03 summary lists 2014 changes only (sick-leave earn-back) and has no parental terms beyond that.

Population: the TAUP unit holds all full-time faculty of the colleges in the unit (Liberal Arts, Science and Technology, Engineering among them; Medicine, Law, Dentistry and Podiatry are excluded), so agreement provisions for faculty are coded main_campus_tenure_stream.

Numbering in the draft: Article 22 cross-references do not match the draft's section letters. EE.1 cites 'Article 22, section G' for paid medical leave (the 2014 summary calls the sick-leave policy 'Article 22.G.1.b'; in the draft it is N.1.b); Art. 11.D.2 cites 'Article 22, Section G7 and Article 22, Section W3' (read as N.7 and EE.3); Side Letters 15-16 cite 'Article 22, Section X' for the Work-Life Balance provision (in the draft X is Leave of Absence, EE is Work-Life Balance). Read as references within the same agreement, not missing documents.

Birth parent chain: faculty sick leave of absence up to 6 months (c1), containing the pregnancy entitlement of 8 weeks at full salary (c3, within c1) and the staged sick pay (c2, within c1; 2 months full, 4 months half), with FMLA 12 weeks alongside from the start (c4 concurrent_with c3 and c1); the primary-caregiver semester of teaching relief (c6) also_available with c3 (no order stated, R3d); a catastrophic-illness extension (c5) consecutive_after c2.

Non-birth parent chain: FMLA 12 weeks unpaid (c4) -> the primary-caregiver semester of teaching relief (c6) if the parent is the primary caregiver (only one of two Temple faculty parents per child); no paid leave of its own.

Coding choice to check (U6): the faculty sick leave is coded as a leave of absence (c1, 6 months) plus its pay (c2) because the texts grant an absence ('may take up to six months of sick leave if accompanied by medical documentation'; return rights while 'out on sick leave and disability', Side Letter 5). This puts 26 weeks of protected leave for the birth parent's own disability in the record.

Conflict: the HR page puts the paid maternity period at 'generally ... 6 to 8 weeks' as medically documented; the agreement 22.N.1.d entitles a female faculty member to 8 weeks of sick leave for pregnancy, more with medical justification. The agreement governs (source precedence): c3 is 8 weeks, flagged conflicting_sources.

Unpaid leave of absence (c9): the grant and the Provost's discretion are stated only on the HR page; the agreement presupposes such leaves (22.X.2 'If a bargaining unit member is granted an unpaid leave of absence'; 22.N.7 'University-approved personal leaves of absence'), so it is not flagged summary_only; it is general_purpose and counted in no figure.

Not components: sabbaticals and fellowship leaves (Art. 23; research purpose, a parent could not use them for a birth; sabbaticals do not stop the tenure clock); funeral leave for academic professionals and librarians (22.AA); librarians' scheduled time off (Art. 16.A.3); librarians keep regular-appointment status during a disability of up to six months (16.C.6; status protection, not leave); Side Letter 19 and 22.P (childcare: committees and proposals only, no benefit); the Transition to Retirement Program (22.U, age 62 and 10 years).

Documents cited but not saved: the Sick Leave Policy for University Employees (governs academic professionals' and librarians' sick accrual, 22.N.2.a; flagged on c15); Temple's Sick Leave Policy and Family and Medical Leave Policy named on the HR page (domestic partners section) as University policies (the agreement's own Sick Leave Policy section N and FMLA section O are coded instead); the Faculty Handbook Section XII (pension definitions only); the Presidential guidelines on Tenure and Promotion; Provost's guidelines of June 12, 2008 (NTT classifications).

Calendar: 'The Academic year shall be divided into (3) three regular semesters: Fall, Spring, and Summer' (19.A.8.a): kind of term stated without length, so calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order.
Statutes: FMLA is the only leave statute named (c4, verified against statute texts 2026_00 and 2026_01). Pennsylvania has no statutory-baseline row and no Pennsylvania leave statute is named.

statutory_floor.statute: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) (29 U.S.C. 2611-2612)
